changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce bulk_operation operation_type at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_bulk_operation ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_bulk_operation_type CHECK (operation_type IN ('DROPOFF', 'ONHOLD', 'REJECTED', 'SUBSTAGE_CHANGE', 'STAGE_ASSIGNMENT_CHANGE', 'TASK_REASSIGN'))

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce bulk_operation status at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_bulk_operation ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_bulk_operation_status CHECK (status IN ('UPLOADED', 'UPLOADED_DRY_RUN', 'VALIDATION_IN_PROGRESS', 'VALIDATION_IN_PROGRESS_DRY_RUN', 'VALIDATED', 'VALIDATED_DRY_RUN', 'VALIDATION_FAILED', 'PROCESSING_IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'PARTIALLY_COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'DRY_RUN_COMPLETED'))
